# Canary — world risk status as_of 2026-11-04T17:53Z · next run ~23:40 UK · stale after 2026-11-05T07:53Z (36h for daily-tier signals) Assessed by an AI model (Anthropic Claude) against published rubrics; attention levels, not forecasts or advice. CC BY 4.0 · https://canary.danleech.com Basis: 26 measured from open data, 12 follow a published figure, 51 are AI judgements from news reports (weigh these with more caution). Known limitations: https://canary.danleech.com/methodology#known-limits
World State 39/100 (Unsettled) · 17 Alert · 37 Watch · 35 Normal Headline: Brent fell to about $94 on US–Iran deal hopes, but Hormuz stays largely shut amid new strikes and IRGC mine claims. North Korea fired missiles on 4 Nov; Democrats won both houses of Congress.
## Situations (9 cross-domain events; Alerts below are grouped under them) - US–Iran war and Gulf energy shock [ALERT, stable]: Trump confirmed strikes on Iranian air defences; Iran called the US reply on Hormuz unconvincing on 4 Nov. Brent fell to about $94 on deal hopes. → alert: gulf-iran, middle-east, oil, eu-gas, fertiliser, chokepoints, freight, uk-energy-cap; watch: iran-nuclear, sanctions, semiconductors - Russia–Ukraine war and NATO's flank [ALERT, worsening]: Toll from 2 Nov strike on a Zaporizhzhia aid point reached 33; Russian strikes on 3 Nov cut power widely. Talks set for 10–11 Nov. → alert: russia-ukraine; watch: russia-nato, nuclear-plants - Super El Niño [ALERT, worsening]: ONI rose to +2.5 for Aug–Oct: drought risk in East and southern Africa, record-range warmth and faster CO₂ growth. → alert: enso, global-temp; watch: drought, co2, famine - Ebola outbreak, DR Congo [ALERT, worsening]: Africa CDC counted 5,376 Ebola deaths among more than 10,000 cases to 2 Nov, mostly in DR Congo; a WHO emergency (PHEIC) since May. → alert: ebola; watch: who-emergencies - Sudan war [ALERT, worsening]: Drone strikes have cut parts of Sudan off the power grid; a strike on a South Kordofan fuel station killed 10 on 4 Nov. → alert: sudan; watch: famine - Cyclone Murasu [ALERT, improving]: Murasu crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast near Ongole on 3 Nov and weakened inland; two dead and 12,230 people moved to relief centres. → alert: other-cyclones - France: debt stress and protests [ALERT, stable]: OAT–Bund spread near 160bp on 2 Nov; budget vote delayed and unions hold a general strike on 5 Nov. → alert: sovereign-debt; watch: civil-unrest - Energy shock feeding inflation [WATCH, worsening]: US CPI 4.0%; Australia hiked to 4.85% on 3 Nov and a Bank of England rise to 4% is expected on 5 Nov. → watch: us-inflation, central-banks, uk-rates, bond-volatility; normal: em-stress - Binance theft and North Korean escalation [WATCH, worsening]: FBI blames North Korea for a $6.3bn Binance theft; Pyongyang denied it and fired missiles on 4 Nov. Binance withdrawals are resuming. → watch: cyber, korea
## Other Alerts - Global food prices [food-prices] stable, AI-judged: FAO food price index 136.0 in September, above the 135 Alert line; October due 6 Nov - UK terrorism threat level [uk-threat-level] stable: UK national threat level Severe: an attack is highly likely
